result.summary: Approve the design: the round-4 flaw is substantively fixed. No assistant-false counterexample outside the named residuals and owner items was demonstrated.

The revised independent model marks the following conclusion true in all three cases.

Verified step-2 suppression: malformed Claude and Codex answer records emit no dialogue, even alongside valid answer text; subsequent conclusions are tainted. The governing clauses are docs/specs/WP-dream-primary-dialogue-projection.md:359–362.

Machinery limitation, nonblocking: the logbook preserves aggregate results but not the authors' complete inputs or executable model. Exact agreement on every original sequence cannot be certified. Preserve those artifacts for reproducible comparison.
